basic_info.description: **Seller is paying 24 months of HOA dues for the buyer**   Come home to a sunny, comfortable, top floor TIC in San Francisco's iconic Nob Hill neighborhood! This is the final unit to be listed in a new 5-unit TIC conversion. All other units are sold. This city sanctuary has two great bedrooms with lots of charm and original detailing. The primary bedroom is also equipped with a large, walk-in closet. The unit is complete with an eat-in kitchen. It also has a combo washer dryer included. Separate, designated storage room is on the first level. The building is perfectly located close to Trader Joe's, Grace Cathedral, and Huntington Park. A great place to call home!  Clear Markoff Report, New Roof and Sirkin Agreement in place. Professional HOA financial management by HOM Works. There are many monthly parking garages 1 block from this home.
